actions.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On agreeing to the resolution Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 271 - 135 (Roll no. 322).
Passed/agreed to in House: On agreeing to the resolution Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 271 - 135 (Roll no. 322).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H6194-6195)

POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on H. Res. 1247, the Chair put the question on agreeing to the resolution and by voice vote, announced that the noes had prevailed. Mr. Takano demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.
The previous question was ordered without objection.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H. Res. 1247.
Considered from the Discharge Calendar. (consideration: CR H6162-6166)
Consideration initiated from the Discharge Calendar.
On motion to discharge Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 245 - 175 (Roll no. 320).
DEBATE - Pursuant to the rule, the House proceeded with 20 minutes of debate on the Takano motion to discharge.
MOTION TO DISCHARGE COMMITTEE - Pursuant to clause 2 of rule XV, Mr. Takano called up motion No. 8, to discharge the Committee on Rules from further consideration of H. Res. 1247.

NOTIFICATION OF INTENT TO OFFER MOTION TO DISCHARGE - Mr. Takano notified the House of his intent to offer a motion to discharge the Committee on Rules from further consideration of H. Res. 1247 pursuant to clause 2(c) of rule XV. The Chair announced that the House will entertain the gentleman's motion within two legislative days.
Motion to discharge the Committee on Rules filed by Mr. Takano. Assigned to the Discharge Calendar, Calendar No. 8.
Motion to Discharge Committee filed by Mr. Takano. Petition No: 119-22. (Discharge petition text with signatures.)
Referred to the House Committee on Rules.

title_official: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2102) to amend title 10, United States Code, to provide for concurrent receipt of veterans' disability compensation and retired pay for disability retirees with combat-related disabilities, and for other purposes.
